LA.onboarding.movement-beta.note.en:
A word on movement. Movement and the automation around it (Overwatch, Engagement, reactions on move, boost split, etc.) hooks into Foundry's v13 move pipeline. The multi step stacks (Boost & Move, Overcharge & Boost & Move) advance on onMove / onActivation, which fire post commit, so each leg has settled before the next one runs.

It's only medium stable though, so a few caveats:

  • Be wary on very vertical maps: heavy climbing / hover / big elevation deltas can throw off the cost math, and the longer chains (3 leg Overcharge path) have the most surface to misbehave.
  • If a stack stalls or a leg lands wrong, fall back to Ignore on the choice card, or hold the free movement key for a single drag.
  • For purely measuring (no token follow, no cost), Ctrl+drag from any empty hex gives you the vanilla ruler.

Predictive / multi waypoint dragging is still beta. If you hit weirdness, splitting the move into two drags usually unblocks it.

LA.settingsMenus.statusFx.lowQuality.hin.en: Outline-only swaps for Overheated, Core Power, Jammed.

LA.settingsMenus.statusFx.master.hint.en: Status glows and auto icons. Needs reload.

LA.settingsMenus.statusFx.reactorExplosi.en: Flash, shockwave, screen shake and scorch marks when a reactor explodes.

LA.status.aided.description.en: You can STABILIZE as a quick action.
LA.status.aided.description.ru: Вы можете совершить Стабилизацию быстрым действием.

LA.status.blinded.description.en: Your line of sight is 1 space.

LA.status.brace.description.en: You resist the triggering attack. Until the end of your next turn, other attacks on you get +1 difficulty and you can't take reactions. On that turn you only get one quick action: no OVERCHARGE, standard move, full or free actions.
LA.status.brace.description.ru: Вы получаете сопротивление к атаке, вызвавшей реакцию. До конца вашего следующего хода другие атаки по вам получают +1 Сложность, а вы не можете совершать реакции. В этот ход у вас только одно быстрое действие: без Форсажа, стандартного перемещения, полных и свободных действий.

LA.status.bulwark.description.en: You count as hard cover and block line of sight.
LA.status.bulwark.description.ru: Вы считаетесь жёстким укрытием и перекрываете линию видимости.

LA.status.climber.description.en: You ignore the extra cost of climbing.
LA.status.climber.description.ru: Вы не платите дополнительную стоимость за лазание.

LA.status.datalinked.description.en: Everyone sees all your stats, current values included.
LA.status.datalinked.description.ru: Все видят все ваши характеристики, включая текущие значения.

LA.status.dazed.description.en: Mechs only. You can only take one quick action: no OVERCHARGE, standard move, full or free actions, or reactions.
LA.status.dazed.description.ru: Только мехи. Вы можете совершить только одно быстрое действие: без Форсажа, стандартного перемещения, полных и свободных действий и реакций.

LA.status.disengage.description.en: You ignore engagement and don't provoke reactions when you move.
LA.status.disengage.description.ru: Вы игнорируете связывание боем и не провоцируете реакции при перемещении.

LA.status.falling.description.en: Falling 3+ spaces without recovering deals 3 Kinetic AP per 3 spaces, max 9. You fall 10 spaces per round, not at all in zero-G or very low G. Falling is involuntary movement.
LA.status.falling.description.ru: Падение на 3+ клетки без восстановления наносит 3 кинетического бронебойного (AP) урона за каждые 3 клетки, максимум 9. Вы падаете на 10 клеток за раунд, а в невесомости или очень низкой гравитации не падаете. Падение — невольное перемещение.

LA.status.grappled.description.en: You are held in a grapple: you are ENGAGED and can't take reactions.
LA.status.grappled.description.ru: Вас удерживают в захвате: вы Связаны боем и не можете совершать реакции.

LA.status.grappling.description.en: You hold someone in a grapple: you are ENGAGED and can't take reactions.
LA.status.grappling.description.ru: Вы удерживаете кого-то в захвате: вы Связаны боем и не можете совершать реакции.

LA.status.guardian.description.en: Adjacent allies can use you as hard cover.
LA.status.guardian.description.ru: Соседние союзники могут использовать вас как жёсткое укрытие.

LA.status.hover.description.en: You hover above the ground and move as if Flying.
LA.status.hover.description.ru: Вы парите над землёй и перемещаетесь как при полёте.

LA.status.infection.description.en: Like Burn, but Heat. You take Heat equal to the Infection received, and it stacks. End of your turn: a SYSTEMS check clears it, or take Heat equal to it. Whatever clears Burn (like STABILIZE) clears it too.
LA.status.infection.description.ru: Как Огонь, но Тепло. Вы получаете Тепло, равное полученному Заражению, и оно суммируется. В конце вашего хода: проверка Систем снимает его, иначе вы получаете Тепло, равное ему. Всё, что снимает Огонь (например, Стабилизация), снимает и его.

LA.status.overheated.description.en: No actions or abilities that inflict Heat on you, including OVERCHARGE and HEAT X (SELF) systems. Weapons lose OVERKILL. STABILIZE clears it.
LA.status.overheated.description.ru: Нельзя использовать действия и способности, дающие вам Тепло, включая Форсаж и системы с ТЕПЛОМ X (НА СЕБЯ). Оружие теряет Сверхурон. Снимается Стабилизацией.

LA.status.phasing.description.en: You can move through characters but can't end your move on them.
LA.status.phasing.description.ru: Вы можете проходить сквозь персонажей, но не можете заканчивать на них перемещение.

LA.status.resistance_all.description.en: Resistance to all damage, burn and heat: take half, rounded up.
LA.status.resistance_all.description.ru: Сопротивление всему урону, Огню и Теплу: вы получаете половину, с округлением вверх.

LA.status.surefoot.description.en: You ignore difficult terrain, but not dangerous terrain.
LA.status.surefoot.description.ru: Вы игнорируете труднопроходимую местность, но не опасную.

LA.status.terrain_immunity.description.en: You ignore difficult and dangerous terrain.
LA.status.terrain_immunity.description.ru: Вы игнорируете труднопроходимую и опасную местность.

LA.status.throttled.description.en: Your attacks deal half damage, heat and burn.
LA.status.throttled.description.ru: Ваши атаки наносят половину урона, Тепла и Огня.

LA.statusShort.DeadRings_statuses_stripp.ru: Вы не получаете пользы от Брони.

LA.statusShort.DeadRings_statuses_vulner.en: A hostile can consume it on a hit for +1d6 bonus damage.
LA.statusShort.DeadRings_statuses_vulner.ru: Враг может израсходовать это при попадании ради +1d6 дополнительного урона.

LA.statusShort.bolster.en: +2 accuracy on your next skill check or save before the end of your next turn. Only one BOLSTER at a time.
LA.statusShort.bolster.ru: +2 Точность на следующую проверку навыка или спасбросок до конца вашего следующего хода. Одновременно действует только одно Усиление.

LA.statusShort.burn.en: It stacks. End of your turn: an ENGINEERING check clears it all, or take Burn damage equal to it.
LA.statusShort.burn.ru: Суммируется. В конце вашего хода: проверка Инженерии снимает весь Огонь, иначе вы получаете урон Огнём, равный ему.

LA.statusShort.cascading.en: One of your NHPs is cascading. SHUT DOWN stabilises it.
LA.statusShort.cascading.ru: Один из ваших NHP в каскаде. Отключение стабилизирует его.

LA.statusShort.cover_hard.en: Ranged attacks against you get +2 difficulty.
LA.statusShort.cover_hard.ru: Атаки дальнего боя по вам получают +2 Сложность.

LA.statusShort.cover_soft.en: Ranged attacks against you get +1 difficulty.
LA.statusShort.cover_soft.ru: Атаки дальнего боя по вам получают +1 Сложность.

LA.statusShort.dangerzone.en: Half or more of your heat is filled in. This enables some attacks, talents and effects.
LA.statusShort.dangerzone.ru: Тепло заполнено наполовину или больше. Это открывает некоторые атаки, таланты и эффекты.

LA.statusShort.downandout.en: Pilots only. You are unconscious and STUNNED, and any more damage kills you. You regain consciousness and half your HP when you rest.
LA.statusShort.downandout.ru: Только пилоты. Вы без сознания и Оглушены, любой дополнительный урон вас убивает. Во время отдыха вы приходите в себя и восстанавливаете половину ОЗ.

LA.statusShort.engaged.en: While adjacent to a hostile, your ranged attacks get +1 difficulty. If a target of equal or greater SIZE engages you during a move, you stop and lose any unused movement.
LA.statusShort.engaged.ru: Пока вы рядом с врагом, ваши атаки дальнего боя получают +1 Сложность. Если цель того же или большего Размера связывает вас боем во время перемещения, вы останавливаетесь и теряете оставшееся перемещение.

LA.statusShort.exposed.en: Kinetic, explosive and energy damage you take is doubled, before reductions. STABILIZE clears it.
LA.statusShort.exposed.ru: Кинетический, взрывной и энергетический урон по вам удваивается до любых снижений. Снимается Стабилизацией.

LA.statusShort.flying.en: You move in three dimensions. If you don't move at least 1 space on your turn, you fall.
LA.statusShort.flying.ru: Вы перемещаетесь в трёх измерениях. Если за свой ход вы не переместились хотя бы на 1 клетку, вы падаете.

LA.statusShort.hidden.en: Hostile attacks and actions can't target you, you don't cause engagement, and enemies only know your rough location. Attacking, forcing a save, a reaction, BOOST or losing cover ends it once resolved. SEARCH finds you.
LA.statusShort.hidden.ru: Враждебные атаки и действия не могут выбрать вас целью, вы не связываете боем, а враги знают лишь ваше примерное местоположение. Атака, навязанный спасбросок, реакция, Рывок или потеря укрытия снимают состояние после разрешения. Поиск обнаруживает вас.

LA.statusShort.immobilized.en: You can't move voluntarily. Involuntary moves still work.
LA.statusShort.immobilized.ru: Вы не можете перемещаться по своей воле. Невольное перемещение работает.

LA.statusShort.impaired.en: +1 difficulty on all your attacks, saves and skill checks.
LA.statusShort.impaired.ru: +1 Сложность на все ваши атаки, спасброски и проверки навыков.

LA.statusShort.intangible.en: You move through characters and terrain but can't end your turn in them. You, your actions and your effects only interact with INTANGIBLE characters and objects, both ways, and tangible characters can pass through you. You aren't adjacent to tangible characters and don't count for sitrep points or zones. Effects already on you stay, ongoing ones like traps or force fields end. Your pilot is INTANGIBLE too.
LA.statusShort.intangible.ru: Вы проходите сквозь персонажей и местность, но не можете заканчивать в них ход. Вы, ваши действия и эффекты взаимодействуете только с Неосязаемыми персонажами и объектами, и наоборот; осязаемые персонажи могут проходить сквозь вас. Вы не считаетесь соседним для осязаемых персонажей и не учитываетесь для очков ситрепа и зон. Уже наложенные эффекты остаются, а длящиеся (ловушки, силовые поля) прекращаются. Ваш пилот тоже Неосязаем.

LA.statusShort.invisible.en: Every attack against you, of any type, has a 50% chance to miss outright, before the roll. You can always HIDE, even without cover.
LA.statusShort.invisible.ru: Любая атака по вам любого типа промахивается с шансом 50 % ещё до броска. Вы всегда можете Скрыться, даже без укрытия.

LA.statusShort.jammed.en: No comms, no reactions, no tech actions or their benefits, and no attacks except IMPROVISED ATTACK, GRAPPLE and RAM.
LA.statusShort.jammed.ru: Нет связи, реакций, тех-действий и их преимуществ, нет атак, кроме Импровизированной атаки, Захвата и Тарана.

LA.statusShort.lockon.en: A hostile can consume it for +1 accuracy on its next attack against you. Some talents and systems need it.
LA.statusShort.lockon.ru: Враг может израсходовать его ради +1 Точности на следующую атаку по вам. Он нужен некоторым талантам и системам.

LA.statusShort.overshield.en: Takes damage before your HP. It doesn't stack, the highest applies.
LA.statusShort.overshield.ru: Принимает урон раньше ваших ОЗ. Не суммируется, действует наибольший.

LA.statusShort.prone.en: Attacks against you get +1 accuracy. You are SLOWED and move as in difficult terrain. Stand up instead of your standard move, unless IMMOBILIZED. Standing up isn't movement and doesn't trigger OVERWATCH.
LA.statusShort.prone.ru: Атаки по вам получают +1 Точность. Вы Замедлены и перемещаетесь как по труднопроходимой местности. Встаньте вместо стандартного перемещения, если не Обездвижены. Вставание — не перемещение и не вызывает Дозор.

LA.statusShort.resistance_burn.en: You take half burn, rounded up.
LA.statusShort.resistance_burn.ru: Вы получаете половину Огня, с округлением вверх.

LA.statusShort.resistance_energy.en: You take half Energy damage, rounded up.
LA.statusShort.resistance_energy.ru: Вы получаете половину энергетического урона, с округлением вверх.

LA.statusShort.resistance_explosive.en: You take half Explosive damage, rounded up.
LA.statusShort.resistance_explosive.ru: Вы получаете половину взрывного урона, с округлением вверх.

LA.statusShort.resistance_heat.en: You take half heat, rounded up.
LA.statusShort.resistance_heat.ru: Вы получаете половину Тепла, с округлением вверх.

LA.statusShort.resistance_kinetic.en: You take half Kinetic damage, rounded up.
LA.statusShort.resistance_kinetic.ru: Вы получаете половину кинетического урона, с округлением вверх.

LA.statusShort.shredded.en: You don't benefit from ARMOR or RESISTANCE.
LA.statusShort.shredded.ru: Вы не получаете пользы от Брони и Сопротивления.

LA.statusShort.shutdown.en: On shut down: heat is cleared, EXPOSED ends, cascading NHPs are stabilised, and statuses from tech actions (like LOCK ON) end. You are immune to all tech, allied included, and STUNNED until it ends. Nothing can prevent this.
LA.statusShort.shutdown.ru: При отключении: Тепло сбрасывается, Открыт снимается, NHP в каскаде стабилизируются, а состояния от тех-действий (например, Захват цели) заканчиваются. Вы невосприимчивы ко всем тех-действиям, включая союзные, и Оглушены до конца отключения. Ничто не может этому помешать.

LA.statusShort.slow.en: Your only movement is your standard move, on your own turn. No BOOST, and no special moves from talents, systems or weapons.
LA.statusShort.slow.ru: Вы можете перемещаться только стандартным перемещением в свой ход. Без Рывка и особых перемещений от талантов, систем и оружия.

LA.statusShort.stunned.en: Mechs only. No OVERCHARGE, movement or actions, free actions and reactions included. EVASION max 5, and HULL and AGILITY checks and saves fail. Your pilot can still MOUNT, DISMOUNT or EJECT and acts normally.
LA.statusShort.stunned.ru: Только мехи. Нет Форсажа, перемещения и действий, включая свободные действия и реакции. Уклонение не больше 5, проверки и спасброски Корпуса и Ловкости проваливаются. Пилот всё ещё может совершить Посадку, Высадку или Катапультирование и действует как обычно.

LA.telemetry.alreadyCounted.en: I'm already counted (Or don't want to be)

LA.telemetry.consent.alreadyCounted.en: Already counted somewhere else (another world or another machine)? Pick "I'm already counted" so you're not double-counted.

LA.telemetry.consent.changeMind.en: You can change your mind anytime in module settings.

LA.telemetry.consent.intro.en: I'd love to know roughly how many people use this module. If you're up for it, just pick the role you usually play.

LA.telemetry.consent.whatSent.en: What gets sent: a random ID generated here, your module version, and your Foundry language. That's it.

LA.tokenHud.detail.clocksBurdens.en: Create and track pilot clocks. Burdens need a bond.
LA.tokenHud.detail.clocksBurdens.ru: Создавайте и отслеживайте часы пилота. Для бремени нужна связь.

LA.tokenHud.detail.contest.en: Contested check between two tokens, each rolling its own stat. Higher total wins.
LA.tokenHud.detail.contest.ru: Состязательная проверка двух токенов, каждый бросает свою характеристику. Побеждает больший итог.

LA.tokenHud.detail.downtime.en: Open the downtime activities dialog, with rolls and journal logging.
LA.tokenHud.detail.downtime.ru: Открыть окно занятий в простое с бросками и записью в журнал.

LA.tokenHud.detail.effectManager.en: Apply statuses, custom effects and bonuses to tokens.
LA.tokenHud.detail.effectManager.ru: Наложить на токены состояния, свои эффекты и бонусы.

LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentAttack.en: Roll a basic attack from the Environment against your target(s).
LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentAttack.ru: Бросить базовую атаку от окружения по вашим целям.

LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentDamage.en: Roll damage from the Environment on your target(s).
LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentDamage.ru: Бросить урон от окружения по вашим целям.

LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentTech.en: Roll a tech attack from the Environment against your target(s).
LA.tokenHud.detail.environmentTech.ru: Бросить тех-атаку от окружения по вашим целям.

LA.tokenHud.detail.forceCheck.en: Send a HASE check to picked tokens, rolled by their owners. With a save target it becomes a save against it.
LA.tokenHud.detail.forceCheck.ru: Отправить проверку HASE выбранным токенам; бросают их владельцы. С указанным значением спасброска это спасбросок против него.

LA.tokenHud.detail.fullRepair.en: Run a Full Repair on the selected unit(s).

LA.tokenHud.detail.generateScan.en: Create the scan journal for the selected token(s).
LA.tokenHud.detail.generateScan.ru: Создать журнал сканирования для выбранных токенов.

LA.tokenHud.detail.linkToToken.en: Link this token to an owner token (deployable-style ownership).
LA.tokenHud.detail.linkToToken.ru: Привязать этот токен к токену-владельцу (как развёртываемый объект).

LA.tokenHud.detail.otherSkillBody.en: Roll a trigger you have no training in: 1d20 + 0. For improvised checks not covered by your Skills or Triggers.
LA.tokenHud.detail.otherSkillBody.ru: Бросок навыка, которым вы не владеете: 1d20 + 0. Для импровизированных проверок, которые не покрывают ваши навыки.

LA.tokenHud.detail.overheat.en: Fill the heat track and roll an overheat check.
LA.tokenHud.detail.overheat.ru: Заполнить шкалу тепла и бросить проверку перегрева.

LA.tokenHud.detail.reactorExplosion.en: Detonate the reactor: blast damage around the token.
LA.tokenHud.detail.reactorExplosion.ru: Взорвать реактор: урон по области вокруг токена.

LA.tokenHud.detail.recharge.en: Roll the NPC recharge flow for uncharged systems.
LA.tokenHud.detail.recharge.ru: Бросить перезарядку NPC для незаряженных систем.

LA.tokenHud.detail.reinforcement.en: Hide selected tokens and reveal them as reinforcements at a target round.
LA.tokenHud.detail.reinforcement.ru: Скрыть выбранные токены и показать их как подкрепление в указанном раунде.

LA.tokenHud.detail.reserve.en: Add a reserve to the pilot.

LA.tokenHud.detail.resurrect.en: Restore this wreck to a live unit.

LA.tokenHud.detail.structure.en: Drop HP to 0 and roll a structure check.
LA.tokenHud.detail.structure.ru: Сбросить ОЗ до 0 и бросить проверку структуры.

LA.tokenHud.detail.vote.en: Start a choice or vote card for the players.
LA.tokenHud.detail.vote.ru: Запустить для игроков карточку выбора или голосования.

LA.tokenHud.ordnanceLocked.en: Ordnance: you moved or acted this turn
LA.tokenHud.ordnanceLocked.ru: Боеприпас: вы перемещались или действовали в этот ход

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.burn.en: Auto: on while Burn is above 0

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.cascading.en: Auto: on while a system is cascading
LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.cascading.ru: Авто: включено, пока система в каскаде

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.core_power_active.en: Auto: on while the core power is active

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.dangerzone.en: Auto: on while Heat is at half or more
LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.dangerzone.ru: Авто: включено, пока Тепло заполнено наполовину или больше

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.infection.en: Auto: on while Infection is above 0

LA.tokenHud.statusAuto.overshield.en: Auto: on while Overshield is above 0

LA.tour.addExtraAddEffectAndExtra.en: Add Extra, Add Effect and Extra Config from an actor or item sheet.

LA.tour.content.aColouredTriangleOnARow.en: A coloured triangle on a row's left edge marks it automated - using it runs its built-in effects.

LA.tour.content.aMeasuringToolsetReusing.en: A measuring toolset reusing LA's targeting visuals - toggle it with Shift+R. Everything lives on this floating toolbar.

LA.tour.content.aPassThroughTheToolsTuck.en: A pass through the tools tucked into the HUD, past just firing weapons.

LA.tour.content.actionsCanAlsoBeAnAttack.en: Actions can also be an attack or damage roll.

LA.tour.content.addExtraOpensThisTieExtr.en: Add Extra opens this: tie extra actions, deployables, and resource bars onto the actor or item.

LA.tour.content.addExtrasAndEffectsToAny.en: Add extras and effects to any actor or item right from its sheet. The L.A button in its header is the entry point; the number shows how much is already attached.

LA.tour.content.addOpensThisEditorTrigge.en: Add opens this editor. Triggers, filters, and code all live here; Save commits, closing discards.

LA.tour.content.addsTheBonusToTheTarget.en: Adds the bonus to the target.

LA.tour.content.allTheCombatFlavorToggle.en: All the combat-flavor toggles: knockback, throw, movement-cap, boost detection, alt structure/stress rules, infection damage. The big stuff.

LA.tour.content.allTheSoundFeedbackOptio.en: All the sound feedback options, including the UI sounds for the TAH.

LA.tour.content.anyRowThatIsNotA.en: Any row that is not a sub-category is an item. Left-click usually activates it; right-click (or Shift+Q) opens a detail popup with its full text.

LA.tour.content.attachDeployablesByActor.en: Attach deployables by actor or LID, or drag one in - this is how an NPC feature gets its deployable in the TAH. The T1/T2/T3 pills gate an entry to that NPC tier; none lit = every tier.

LA.tour.content.bindItToAnItemBy.en: Bind it to an item (by LID) or make it general - checked on every token.

LA.tour.content.clickTheMagnifierOrPress.en: Click the magnifier or press Shift+F to live-filter every action.

LA.tour.content.clickTheNameToOpenThe.en: Click the name to open the actor sheet.

LA.tour.content.clickTheSwordsIconToAdd.en: Click the swords icon to add or remove the token from the combat tracker without leaving the HUD.

LA.tour.content.clickToExpandArmorEvasio.en: Click to expand armor, evasion, e-defense, tech attack, save, sensors, and core.

LA.tour.content.codingAndAutomationCanFe.en: Coding and automation can feel rough, and mid-game you need stuff fast. Here's a UI on top of the Lancer Automations systems, no code.

LA.tour.content.createANewOneYouLl.en: Create a new one. You'll pick item-bound (LID) or general, the triggers, and the code blocks that run on evaluate / activate / init.

LA.tour.content.ctrlRightClickAnyActionT.en: Ctrl+Right-click any action to pick which wheel it goes on. The mark on a row says where it lives. Hover the star in the Menu band to open the list.

LA.tour.content.customActionsBoltedOntoT.en: Custom actions bolted onto the actor or item - name, activation, icon, optional resource limits. They show up in the TAH.

LA.tour.content.customIsYourOwnStuffDefa.en: Custom is your own stuff. Defaults are the activations bundled with the module. Startup is JS that runs once on Foundry ready.

LA.tour.content.dragATokenToMeasureThe.en: Drag a token to measure. The ruler follows Lancer rules: speed cap, terrain cost, climb, flight ceiling.

LA.tour.content.driveTheHudByKeyboardShi.en: Drive the HUD by keyboard: Shift+WASD moves, Shift+1-9 jumps to a row, Shift+E left-clicks, Shift+Q right-clicks, Shift+F searches, Escape backs out.

LA.tour.content.duringADragPressMTo.en: During a drag, press M to cycle the type for that drag only - the token's base type stays put.

LA.tour.content.everyPageGroupsRelatedSt.en: Every page groups related stuff, sorted by family on the left. The search box up top looks through all of them at once.

LA.tour.content.everythingCurrentlyOnATo.en: Everything currently on a token, including passive bonuses you can't see otherwise (Veterancy adding a passive on a HASE check, etc.).

LA.tour.content.filterByNameLidOrTrigger.en: Filter by name, LID, or trigger type. Handy when the list gets long.

LA.tour.content.fixesForIsometricModules.en: Fixes for isometric modules (Isometric Perspective, Grape Juice). Only shows when one is active.

LA.tour.content.flipTheseOnIfSomethingFe.en: Flip these on if something feels off and you want to see what the module is doing under the hood.

LA.tour.content.forItemBoundActivationsT.en: For item-bound activations, the item's Lancer ID. The finder button beside it searches your items and compendiums, so you don't type it by hand.

LA.tour.content.forceIsUnintentionalMove.en: Force is unintentional movement (knockback, drag): it doesn't trigger move automations like Overwatch.

LA.tour.content.halfSizeTokensAutoWallHe.en: Half-size tokens, auto wall-height for tokens, my own token stat bars (a Bar Brawl alternative). Mostly QoL display tweaks.

LA.tour.content.hereYouCanEnableTheTah.en: Here you can enable the TAH, my own Token Action HUD. It offers a bunch of tools, with UI and sound, and a few options to tune it. Still work in progress but fairly usable.

LA.tour.content.holdVForFreeMovementNo.en: Hold V for free movement (no cost, ignores terrain). Hold B for debug movement (skips automation hooks). Ctrl+drag from empty space gives the vanilla ruler.

LA.tour.content.hoverHereForTheFullCheat.en: Click here for the full cheat-sheet. Quick ones: Ctrl+wheel rotate, Shift+wheel size, Q/E elevation, W/S tilt a line, Z reset.

LA.tour.content.howActivationPopupsFeelD.en: How activation popups feel during play: who sees them, whether the reaction is auto-spent, and a couple of niche toggles.

LA.tour.content.howLongItSticksEndStart.en: How long it sticks: end/start of turn, indefinite, etc.

LA.tour.content.jsThatRunsOnceOnFoundry.en: JS that runs once on Foundry ready. Good for helper functions you want your activations to reuse.

LA.tour.content.liveVitalsHpHeatStructur.en: Live vitals: HP, heat, structure and stress pips, overshield, burn.

LA.tour.content.makeFoldersToKeepThingsT.en: Make folders to keep things tidy. Drag rows in to file them.

LA.tour.content.myOptionalContentPacksPe.en: My optional content packs (personal stuff), the News & Releases history, and one-shot maintenance buttons: LCP repair, reset, export, import.

LA.tour.content.nameIconDurationNoteSame.en: Name, icon, duration, note. Same shape as Standard but for ad-hoc statuses.

LA.tour.content.narrowWhenItFiresReactTo.en: Narrow when it fires: react to self or others, disposition, in or out of combat, auto-activate.

LA.tour.content.oneSaveCommitsEveryTabAt.en: One Save commits every tab at once. Some changes need a reload, you'll be prompted on close.

LA.tour.content.optionalAutoConsumeTrigg.en: Optional auto-consume trigger (on hit, on damage, on turn end...). Picking some triggers reveals extra filters: item LID, action name, status, check type.

LA.tour.content.pickAShapeBlastBurstCone.en: Pick a shape - Blast, Burst, Cone, Line - or Mark for gold marks. Elevation makes it 3D, Terrain follows the ground, Spread propagates cell to cell.

LA.tour.content.pickAStatusAndAStack.en: Pick a status and a stack count. Target is up top.

LA.tour.content.pressFOnASelectedToken.en: Press F with a token selected: your favorites form a wheel at the cursor. Click an icon to use it, right-click for its details, hover for the range preview. Tab switches to the next wheel once you have more than one.

LA.tour.content.pressGForTheStatusesOn.en: Press G for the statuses on the token plus the ones starred in the status panel. Click to apply or add a stack, right-click to remove one. Removing a permanent effect asks first.

LA.tour.content.pressMOnASelectedToken.en: Press M on a selected token to open this wheel and set its base movement type - walk, fly, drift, each with its own cost rules.

LA.tour.content.prettySimpleHereSTheConf.en: Pretty simple, here's the configuration menu where all the Lancer Automations options live. Note: some settings are client-side (per user) and not shared world-wide (Token Action HUD, custom stat bars, vision debug overlays, etc.). Each player must enable them on their own client.

LA.tour.content.pulseARangeAroundTheShap.en: Pulse a range around the hovered or selected token: a manual radius, threat, sensor, max reach, or a weapon's range. T cycles sources, re-clicking the active one turns it off. A movement-reach toggle is here too.

LA.tour.content.quickAddAManualTokenStat.en: Quick-add a manual token stat bar to track anything you like.

LA.tour.content.quickFullReactionProtoco.en: Quick / Full / Reaction / Protocol / Move pips. Click to spend, right-click to restore; on your turn the spent slot becomes End Turn. It mirrors Lancer\'s own action tracker, so you can disable that one in the Lancer system settings.

LA.tour.content.reOpenActivationManager.en: Re-open this any time from the Automation Manager button in the Game Settings sidebar, under the LANCER section.

LA.tour.content.reOpenThisAnyTimeFrom.en: Re-open this any time from the Lancer Automations button in the Game Settings sidebar, under the LANCER section.

LA.tour.content.reRunTheSetupWizardOr.en: Re-run the Setup Wizard, or launch any tour: Token Action HUD, ruler & movement, advanced measure, effect manager, automation. They can run long - start one now or come back whenever.

LA.tour.content.registeringEveryPossible.en: Registering every possible status from NPC stuff is tedious and noisy on the status list. This tab lets you create temporary statuses on the fly. With my temporary-custom-statuses module some can be saved and reused.

LA.tour.content.revertTheLastMoveOrClear.en: Revert the last action, or clear this token\'s recorded history.

LA.tour.content.rightClickARangeSourceOr.en: Right-click a range source (or a weapon in its list) to pin it: a steady ring that stays on the map after you close the tool, on as many tokens as you want. The ★ on the Range button counts pins. The TAH range toggles pin the same way.

LA.tour.content.rightClickAnyItemOrShift.en: Right-click any item (or Shift+Q) to open a detail popup: full text, tags, and any Disable / Destroy toggles.

LA.tour.content.sameTriggerPickerAsStand.en: Same trigger picker as Standard. Combined with Uses, this is how you build things like 3 stacks of +1d6 damage on next attack, consumed on damage roll.

LA.tour.content.saveAFilledInEffectAs.en: Save a filled-in effect as a preset and reload it later - handy for ones you apply often.

LA.tour.content.shiftClickInFreeModeMark.en: Shift+click in free mode marks a token (shows its range and reach) or the ground (manual-range only). Hold Ctrl for the vanilla Measure Distance ruler.

LA.tour.content.statusesSavedThroughTemp.en: Statuses saved through temporary-custom-statuses show up here for reuse, and on a separate Statuses tab in TAH.

LA.tour.content.subCategoriesOfToolsGame.en: Sub-categories of tools: Gameplay actions, Movement helpers, Measures (the Advanced Measure tool), Log, Glossary, and a Misc grab-bag.

LA.tour.content.thatSTheToolboxDigThroug.en: That's the toolbox. Dig through Utility for the rest.

LA.tour.content.theActivationsBundledWit.en: The activations bundled with the module: Overwatch, Brace, Flight, Fall, plus a bunch of NPC-feature automations. Toggle them on or off.

LA.tour.content.theAdvancedStuffAndOneOf.en: The advanced stuff, and one of the core features of the Lancer Automations engine. Many many things go through here: accuracy, damage on next attack, immunities, rerolls, target modifiers. They inject into the regular Lancer system cards seamlessly. Read doc/API_EFFECTS.md for the full menu.

LA.tour.content.theBonusTypeEachOneRevea.en: The bonus type. Each one reveals its own fields below.

LA.tour.content.theEditorSuggestsApiName.en: The editor suggests API names as you type. Press Alt-Enter to open the list, then arrow through to see what each does.

LA.tour.content.theFxSectionStatusVisual.en: The FX section: status visual effects (glows, shaders) plus the extra statuses I added. A bit like Lancer QoL, so pick one or the other if both are on.

LA.tour.content.theLAButtonOpensThis.en: The L.A button opens this menu. Add Effect opens the Effect Manager for this sheet, Add Extra attaches actions/deployables/bars, and Extra Config (items only) tunes auto-consume and deployable range/count.

LA.tour.content.theLancerAutomationsToke.en: The Lancer Automations Token Action HUD - your token's action menu.

LA.tour.content.theMenuColumnListsCatego.en: The Menu column lists categories (Actions, Weapons, Systems, Frame, Talents, Utility, Statuses). Hovering or clicking a row cascades extra columns out to the right.

LA.tour.content.theRightNumberIsTheMax.en: The right number is the max move this turn (speed); the left is what the token has used so far. Boost (or anything granting extra move) extends the cap.

LA.tour.content.theStandardEffectPagePic.en: The standard effect page. Pick a status, a duration, optionally an auto-consume trigger.

LA.tour.content.thereIsALotMoreUnder.en: There is a lot more under the hood, but the tour would get long. Drop by Discord if you have questions.

LA.tour.content.tickTheTriggersThatFireI.en: Tick the triggers that fire it: onMove, onHit, onActivation, onStructure, and many more.

LA.tour.content.tokenActionHudIsOffEnabl.en: Token Action HUD is off. Enable it for the tour?

LA.tour.content.unlockWithTheLockIconThe.en: Unlock with the lock icon, then drag the HUD anywhere. The reset icon restores its position.

LA.tour.content.visionFromEdgeForBigToke.en: Vision-from-edge for big tokens, the Lancer Sensors and Battlefield Awareness detection modes (auto-add, combat-only, range source), basic-sight overrides, and drag-vision behavior all live here.

LA.tour.content.whatHappensWhenSomething.en: What happens when something dies. Spawn a wreck token, play the explosion, optionally drop terrain. Per-category if you want monstrosity wrecks to look different from mech wrecks.

LA.tour.content.whereYouBuildAutomations.en: Where you build automations. Item-bound (per LID) or general, code-driven, fired on triggers like onMove, onHit, onActivation, and so on.

LA.tour.content.yourActivationsGroupedIn.en: Your activations, grouped into folders. Each row binds to one or more triggers and runs your code.

LA.tour.content.yourLogicEvaluateShouldI.en: Your logic: evaluate (should it fire?), activation (what happens), plus onInit and onMessage.

LA.tour.guidedWalkthroughOfEveryTabIn.en: Guided walkthrough of every tab in the Lancer Automations configuration window.

LA.tour.placeTokenBody.en: Drop a player mech onto the scene and select it, then click Continue. Talents, Frame and mounts are mech-only, so an NPC won't do, and an unequipped mech leaves the weapon steps with nothing to point at.

LA.tour.placeTokenSubtitle.en: The TAH tour needs a mech token.

LA.tour.resumeBody.en: You can re-launch this tour later from Configure Settings > Module Settings > Lancer Automations > Tour, or from Foundry's Configure Tours menu.

LA.tour.resumeSubtitle.en: Take the tour now or later.

LA.tour.theAdvancedMeasureToolShapesRang.en: The Advanced Measure tool: shapes, ranges, markers, and shortcuts.

LA.tour.theGameplayToolsInsideTheToken.en: The gameplay tools inside the Token Action HUD: skirmish/barrage, boost, deploy, contest, scan, link, reinforcement, downtime, reserve, vote.

LA.tour.theMovementWheelMovementTypesAnd.en: The movement wheel, movement types, and the free/debug keys.

LA.tour.walksThroughTheActivationManager.en: Walks through the Automation Manager dialog (custom activations, defaults, startup scripts).

LA.tour.walksThroughTheEffectManagerDial.en: Walks through the Effect Manager dialog (standard, custom, bonus, manage).

LA.tour.walksThroughTheTokenActionHud.en: Walks through the Token Action HUD on a controlled token.

LA.tour.welcome.dense.en: It's a very dense, powerful, big module. Its use is mainly for me, so the design is catered to what I like.

LA.tour.welcome.firstTime.en: First time here? Hit Setup Wizard to turn the module's main features on or off with a few plain yes/no questions, then take the tour.

LA.tour.welcome.help.en: If you have any question or issue, head out to the Lancer Discord, or come talk to me directly on my channel.

LA.tour.welcome.lastWarning.en: Last warning: if you installed this without reading the documentation, please go read it. This is not a plug and play module, and you have to be serious about that.

LA.tour.welcome.subtitle.en: A module that went way bigger than I initially planned.

LA.tour.welcome.support.en: This module is free and always will be. If you wanna support my late nights, Patreon or Ko-fi.

LA.tour.welcome.thanks.en: First of all, thanks for downloading.

LA.tour.welcome.tours.en: Since it's a big module, here's a set of tours for the important stuff. They can run long, so take them one at a time and come back later.

LA.vision.blocksLaLosOnly.en: Blocks LA Line of Sight Only

LA.vision.blocksLaLosOnlyTip.en: Blocks Lancer line of sight, not Foundry vision.

LA.vision.blocksLosTip.en: Token blocks line of sight through its bounding box. The Bulwark status enables this automatically while active.

LA.vision.fromEdgeTip.en: Vision computed from the token's perimeter (Lancer LOS-style) so larger tokens can peek around corners. 'Default' follows the world setting.

LA.wreck.pickFolderTip.en: Pick a folder: a random file is used on each death

LA.wreck.unlinkScanPrompt.en: Remove the scan flag from {count} journal(s) linked to {name}? The journals are not deleted.
